description: Declaration of the direct lender→borrower SPEI that FUNDS a loan (non-custodial model, RFC-002, architecture v1.2 D13). Funding is NOT a payment: it creates the active loan, it does not amortize it — hence its own table and aggregate. SmartLoans never touches the money: the lender declares the transfer (clave de rastreo), the borrower confirms reception, and only then the loan becomes active. No response escalates to support (D5: money is NEVER auto-confirmed). Every status change must also INSERT into paymentHistory (D16).

fields.name: loanId
fields.description: Loan being funded. UNIQUE — exactly one funding per loan.

fields.name: lenderClientId
fields.description: Payer — sent the SPEI from their own bank.

fields.name: borrowerClientId
fields.description: Payee — must confirm reception in their own bank account.

fields.name: amountMXN
fields.description: Declared amount, must match the intent expectedAmountMXN within $1 tolerance. Positive, decimal(18,2).

fields.name: transferDate
fields.description: Date the SPEI was sent, between today-30d and today.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Allowed values: PENDING_CONFIRMATION, CONFIRMED, REJECTED, ESCALATED, CANCELLED. Defaults to PENDING_CONFIRMATION. Never auto-confirmed by the system.

fields.name: declaredAt
fields.description: When the lender declared. Defaults to GETUTCDATE().

fields.name: confirmedAt
fields.description: When the borrower (or support on escalation) confirmed reception.

fields.name: confirmedByClientId
fields.description: WHO confirmed: the borrower, or the support actor that resolved an escalation. Audit-critical.

fields.name: escalatedAt
fields.description: Set by the escalate cron when the borrower has not responded after the configured days.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
One funding transaction activates one loan.

components.name: FundingTransactionListStep
components.description: IonList newest-first by companyId: loanId, lender→borrower, amountMXN, transferDate, status chip (PENDING amber / CONFIRMED green / REJECTED red / ESCALATED purple).

hints: Status machine: PENDING_CONFIRMATION -> CONFIRMED | REJECTED | ESCALATED; ESCALATED -> CONFIRMED | REJECTED (support only). Any other transition returns an error.
UNIQUE constraint on loanId (one funding per loan).

Every status change must INSERT a row into dbo.paymentHistory (subjectType='FUNDING', subjectId=fundingId, oldStatus, newStatus, actorUserId, reason) inside the same transaction — paymentHistory is append-only.
Extra action 'escalate_due': PENDING_CONFIRMATION rows with declaredAt older than @days → ESCALATED, returning affected rows for the support queue.
confirm action must return the loanId and borrowerUserId/lenderUserId so the caller can transition the loan to funded→active and push both parties.
Amount is validated against the intent expectedAmountMXN within 1.00 tolerance on declare (action 1).
